description: Mounted on a carrier-deck-style plinth in a fountain basin at Laman Pahlawan, Bukit Chandan, in the royal town of Kuala Kangsar, alongside a Condor APC and a Daimler Ferret. Tourism interpretation boards were installed by the Kuala Kangsar Municipal Council in January 2023 in collaboration with the Malaya Historical Group Society. Reported in a state of disrepair in March 2018, with the canopy ajar and the fountain not working. No serial has been published; the variant is given as PTM because the RMAF operated no other single-seat Skyhawk standard.
